objective: Map the audit-method-data-flow v0.2.1 release candidate's identity, package integrity, confidential local method/claim/evidence contract, recursive paper-quality and independent-artifact gates, managed maintenance and repair boundaries, and pending public lifecycle gates.

elements.target: Version, citation, license, changelog, and packaged version identify one v0.2.1 MIT release candidate.
elements.safe_interpretation: Mapped version, citation, changelog, package-version, and regression-test sources define one local v0.2.1 candidate; executed release evidence remains separate.

elements.target: The release-candidate package tree binds ordinary files while accepting only allowlisted GitHub-managed frontmatter metadata, including an optional github-pinned value that exactly matches an allowed release tag.
elements.safe_interpretation: Mapped integrity implementation, package manifest, and regression sources define ordinary-file drift detection and allowlisted tag-matching GitHub metadata; public v0.2.1 pinned verification remains pending.

elements.target: After substantive use, the skill runs consent-gated update maintenance and emits one tested content-free receipt. It documents an external analyze-project-claims handoff for an owner-bound local recommended-update preview and separate public approval, but this repository does not execute or verify that consumer behavior. Separately, one closed repository policy and thin full-SHA-pinned caller permit only owner-triaged, protected-environment-gated draft repair without authorizing telemetry, project-content transport, evidence acceptance, merge, release, or installed replacement.
elements.safe_interpretation: Mapped package and policy sources define consent-gated local maintenance, content-free receipts, owner-bound external preview, and a thin disabled repair caller; hosted execution and public submission remain unobserved.

elements.target: The skill requires explicit dataset, label, component, transformation, output, evaluation, counterevidence, and claim-boundary relations. Its default paper-quality gate reruns all applicable checks after repair, keeps any PENDING item open, and treats three cycles as a safety bound rather than completion.
elements.safe_interpretation: Mapped skill, claim-chain reference, and regression sources define explicit method/claim relations, conclusion synthesis, auditable dispositions, and a bounded fail-closed repair-and-recheck loop.

elements.target: The skill provides a bounded local JSON contract for authorization, confidentiality, complete method branches, cross-section claims, and hash-bound evidence; reports identify gaps by stable ID without echoing claim prose or performing external processing.
elements.safe_interpretation: The mapped local validator and tests define structural PASS/PARTIAL/BLOCKED outcomes, fail-closed authorization gates, stable relations, bounded input, content-minimized output, and no network transport. They do not establish scientific validity.

elements.target: The skill defines source-backed semantic-universality, first-reader definition, counted-component membership, reader-facing citation closure, and matched-row numerical table contracts. It requires an active inventory and explicit terminology scope for independently readable manuscripts, technical appendices, supplement entry documents, release guides, upload copies, and generated archives.
elements.safe_interpretation: Mapped skill, terminology/display references, and regression sources define the declared reader-facing terminology, citation, figure, table, slide, independent-artifact, archive-content, and generated-artifact contracts.

elements.target: Bounded v0.1.3 public release, unpinned replacement, Codex activation, Claude placement, and pinned-install failure evidence is separated from pending v0.2.1 CI, immutable release, pinned verification, and activation evidence.
elements.safe_interpretation: Historical v0.1.3 consumer evidence remains bounded. The local v0.2.1 candidate still requires PR/main CI, immutable publication, pinned installation verification, and fresh available-client activation.
elements.required_repair: Complete the documented external release and consumer smoke gates without broadening their evidence scope.

strongest_safe_claim: The local audit-method-data-flow v0.2.1 candidate is structurally mapped across release identity, package integrity, a confidential local method/claim/evidence contract, recursive paper-quality and independent-artifact gates, managed maintenance, content-free quality handoff, and owner-gated repair boundaries.
claim_boundary: This structural map and local source/test inspection do not establish scientific validity, public v0.2.1 CI or publication, protected hosted repair gates, public pinned installation, client activation, or public issue submission.
unresolved_uncertainties: The v0.2.1 PR and exact-main CI have not passed.
The v0.2.1 tag and immutable release do not exist.
Public pinned v0.2.1 package verification and fresh available-client activation are unobserved.
Scientific correctness and completeness of any project-specific contract require human review and direct project evidence.
